headline: Iran targets commercial ships, Dubai airport and oil facilities as concerns grow over global energy
summary: Iran's joint military command said it would target commercial ships, Dubai airport and oil facilities, and would also start targeting banks and financial institutions.
why: Shipping lanes, energy infrastructure and the Gulf financial system are central to global trade and capital flows, so threats against them affect markets broadly.
why_moved: Explicit threats against commercial ships and oil facilities raise fears of disruption to global energy supply.
